text:
Alex B: Quick check — are we locked for v0.24.0 cutoff at 18:00 UTC today? I want to double-check the branch strategy before I start the backport.
Maria G: yes locked from product side. docs + changelog still need a final pass though.
Alex B: ok - planning to cut release branch from main at 17:45 UTC and then do cherry-picks for the hotfixes. anyone object?
Cheng L: security review for the serialization change is still pending. I can finish it by 17:10 if we prioritize.
Priya S: I'll take the changelog edit. @Maria G can you confirm the customer-facing wording for the cache-behavior note?
Maria G: pinged product for wording now, will post the final sentence in ~10m.
Matthew D: CI looks green for main. One flaky test kept failing in nightly but it's unrelated to release files.
Alex B: thanks. plan: create branch release/v0.24.0 at 17:45, then run `scripts/release/checklist.sh` and open PRs for cherry-picks. Here's the commands I’ll run:

```
git checkout -b release/v0.24.0 origin/main
./scripts/release/checklist.sh --validate
# cherry-pick hotfix PRs
git cherry-pick -x <commit-hash>
git push origin release/v0.24.0
```

Alex B: will tag @release-bot for the official cut once PRs are merged.
release-bot: Reminder: release branch cutoff scheduled at 2026-03-17T18:00:00Z for v0.24.0. Please ensure all PRs are merged or marked for post-release.
Priya S: changelog draft: "fix(router): preserve kv-cache order during rehydrate — fixes intermittent duplicate keys" — anybody want to tweak wording?
Cheng L: security note — serialization change adds a safe-guard using a allowlist; I left the check in a separate commit and flagged it in the security review PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/4821
Maria G: product wording: "Improves cache consistency, resolves edge case with duplicate keys during rehydrate; no breaking changes." go with that.
Alex B: perfect. I'll include that in the changelog under bug fixes.
Matthew D: QA signoff: I can run the smoke suite on the release branch after it's created. ETA 20m.
Alex B: if Cheng can finish security by 17:10 and Maria confirms wording, I’ll cut at 17:45 and assign cherry-picks. @Priya S please open the changelog PR against release branch after cut.
Priya S: will do. I'll include PR list and changelog diff.
Cheng L: security review complete — acked and added a migration note in the PR description. No blockers.
Maria G: product confirmed wording posted in the docs channel: https://docs.company/changes/v0.24.0
Alex B: ok cutting in 5. stand by for PR links.
Alex B: opened release branch: https://git.company/repo/compare/release/v0.24.0
Alex B: cherry-pick PRs opened: https://git.company/repo/pull/4830, https://git.company/repo/pull/4831
Matthew D: smoke suite started on release/v0.24.0 — currently running 34/42 tests.
release-bot: CI status: release/v0.24.0 — 1 failing check (flake-detector). See https://ci.company/build/9876
Priya S: changelog PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/4832 — includes product wording and entry for the cache-fix.
Matthew D: smoke suite passed 42/42. small timing regression on reroute, but not blocking.
Alex B: merging cherry-picks now, will request final sign-offs. @Cheng L can you +1 security in the PR comments? @Maria G can you add product sign-off?
Cheng L: +1 in PR comments.
Maria G: product sign-off added.
Alex B: merged, tagging release-bot for the cut.
release-bot: Release v0.24.0 prep complete. Tagging: v0.24.0. Kickoff deployment window 19:00 UTC.
Alex B: thanks team — great coordination. I'll post a post-release note in #eng-releases when deploy is green. :tada:
